MUS_LB_Chase.listen: 120 BPM, 8.000 s: double heartbeat thump on beat 1 and the 'and' after it, a low growling saw ostinato in eighths, and a quiet rising noise swell over 4 bars that drops out on the next downbeat. Loop it: the join must stay on the beat. (The listed seam step is the downbeat thump arriving after the swell peak, by design, not a fault.)
MUS_LB_Chase.name: MUS_LB_Chase

MUS_LB_Drone_A.listen: Very low (A1) detuned buzzing stack with a semitone and tritone clash swelling in and out; a dark filter slowly opens over 40 s and closes over 20 s; a little air on top. Menacing, not melodic.
MUS_LB_Drone_A.name: MUS_LB_Drone_A

MUS_LB_Drone_B.listen: The bell's hum and tierce as slow swelling tones (4 s attack) that beat, plus one faint distant cracked bell strike inside the drone (about 22 s in). Should feel like the bell 'breathing'.
MUS_LB_Drone_B.name: MUS_LB_Drone_B

MUS_LB_Drone_C.listen: A breathy low 'oo' choir: formant-filtered noise with slow swells and a faint low minor chord underneath. Listen for anything that sounds like a synth pad rather than breath.
MUS_LB_Drone_C.name: MUS_LB_Drone_C

MUS_LB_Sting_Apparition.listen: 3 s of whispering breath with syllable-like bursts swelling and fading, drifting between the ears. Should sound like a voice almost making words.
MUS_LB_Sting_Apparition.name: MUS_LB_Sting_Apparition

MUS_LB_Sting_Caught.listen: Immediate heavy low hit and boom, with a reversed cracked bell swelling underneath that cuts off at ~2.5 s.
MUS_LB_Sting_Caught.name: MUS_LB_Sting_Caught

MUS_LB_Sting_Spotted.listen: 2 s of rising dissonant saws and noise, then a hard hit at 2.0 s. (The hit lands ~1.4 s after the chase starts: say if it should be shorter.)
MUS_LB_Sting_Spotted.name: MUS_LB_Sting_Spotted

MUS_LB_Tension.listen: No pulse. Thick, clashing string-like saws with a fast 5 Hz flutter and a faint glassy shimmer on top. Uneasy, steady, loops every 32 s.
MUS_LB_Tension.name: MUS_LB_Tension

SFX_LB_Bell_Stage1.listen: FARTHEST. Dull (low-passed 900 Hz), washed in 6 s of reverb, a slow wobbling beat on the hum/prime: cracked, distant. Intended 18 dB under stage 5.
SFX_LB_Bell_Stage1.name: SFX_LB_Bell_Stage1

SFX_LB_Bell_Stage2.listen: Closer: still dark (1.5 kHz) but the beating is faster and rougher; very slight wavering pitch (+-4 cents). -14 dB.
SFX_LB_Bell_Stage2.name: SFX_LB_Bell_Stage2

SFX_LB_Bell_Stage3.listen: Closer again (2.5 kHz), harsh distortion, and the pitch sags 20 cents over the tail. -10 dB.
SFX_LB_Bell_Stage3.name: SFX_LB_Bell_Stage3

SFX_LB_Bell_Stage4.listen: Close and brutal: full bandwidth, hardest crack, with a 1.2 s reversed swell before the strike. -6 dB.
SFX_LB_Bell_Stage4.name: SFX_LB_Bell_Stage4

SFX_LB_Bell_Stage5.listen: FINALE: clean, pure, no beating, huge 8 s reverb and a 27.5 Hz sub hum for 30 s. Full level (0 dB).
SFX_LB_Bell_Stage5.name: SFX_LB_Bell_Stage5

SFX_LB_Drip_Stone_01.listen: A tiny hard 'tick' of water on stone with a faint body. Dry and short; should not sound like a click track.
SFX_LB_Drip_Stone_01.name: SFX_LB_Drip_Stone_01

SFX_LB_Drip_Stone_02.listen: A tiny hard 'tick' of water on stone with a faint body. Dry and short; should not sound like a click track.

SFX_LB_Drip_Water_01.listen: A single water drip: a quick rising 'bloop' then a short bubble ring. Compare the 5: each pitch/length differs.
SFX_LB_Drip_Water_01.name: SFX_LB_Drip_Water_01

SFX_LB_Rain_In.listen: Same rain heard through a roof: dull, slower patter plus a few big drips (plinks). Should read as 'under cover'.
SFX_LB_Rain_In.name: SFX_LB_Rain_In

SFX_LB_Rain_Out.listen: Steady wide hiss with fine sizzle and low splatter, no obvious repeat or pumping. Bright, close.
SFX_LB_Rain_Out.name: SFX_LB_Rain_Out

SFX_LB_Room_Belfry.listen: Open and windy: audible wind and howl, almost no air bed. The most exposed of the six.
SFX_LB_Room_Belfry.name: SFX_LB_Room_Belfry

SFX_LB_Room_Chapel.listen: Quiet air with a faint hollow wind through the roof hole (nothing below 300 Hz in the wind part).
SFX_LB_Room_Chapel.name: SFX_LB_Room_Chapel

SFX_LB_Room_Cloister.listen: Light open air, almost nothing. The calmest of the six.
SFX_LB_Room_Cloister.name: SFX_LB_Room_Cloister

SFX_LB_Room_Crypt.listen: Very dark: a 40 Hz throb, dull air and far-off dripping water with a damp tail. Oppressive, should be felt more than heard.
SFX_LB_Room_Crypt.name: SFX_LB_Room_Crypt

SFX_LB_Room_Passage.listen: Tight air with a faint low draught drifting around 180 Hz.
SFX_LB_Room_Passage.name: SFX_LB_Room_Passage

SFX_LB_Room_Tower.listen: Low hollow air plus a distant howl gliding around 450 Hz.
SFX_LB_Room_Tower.name: SFX_LB_Room_Tower

SFX_LB_SmallBell_Fail.listen: All four bells at once, each out of tune, harsh and clashing: unmistakably WRONG.
SFX_LB_SmallBell_Fail.name: SFX_LB_SmallBell_Fail

SFX_LB_SmallBell_Solved.listen: Four bells rising in order, then a low C resonance swelling under and fading: a reward, not a fanfare.
SFX_LB_SmallBell_Solved.name: SFX_LB_SmallBell_Solved

SFX_LB_SmallBell_Strike.listen: One bright small bell (C5, 523 Hz), 4 s ring, slight beat. In game it is pitched per bell (x1/size).
SFX_LB_SmallBell_Strike.name: SFX_LB_SmallBell_Strike

SFX_LB_Thunder_Far_01.listen: Slow swell, dull low grumble (nothing above ~200 Hz), ~5 s. Far away; meant to sit 8 dB under the others.
SFX_LB_Thunder_Far_01.name: SFX_LB_Thunder_Far_01

SFX_LB_Thunder_Far_02.listen: Slow swell, dull low grumble (nothing above ~200 Hz), ~5 s. Far away; meant to sit 8 dB under the others.

SFX_LB_Thunder_Mid_01.listen: No crack: a 1.5 s rise into a ~6 s rolling rumble. Medium distance.
SFX_LB_Thunder_Mid_01.name: SFX_LB_Thunder_Mid_01

SFX_LB_Thunder_Near_01.listen: Sharp crack in the first 40 ms, then a deep rolling rumble with 3-6 surges over 7-9 s. Close and big.
SFX_LB_Thunder_Near_01.name: SFX_LB_Thunder_Near_01

SFX_LB_Thunder_Near_02.listen: Sharp crack in the first 40 ms, then a deep rolling rumble with 3-6 surges over 7-9 s. Close and big.

SFX_LB_Thunder_Strike_01.listen: Double crack 60 ms apart, 400 ms of tearing, low thump, then a short rumble. LOUD and sharp: the tower strike.
SFX_LB_Thunder_Strike_01.name: SFX_LB_Thunder_Strike_01

SFX_LB_Thunder_Strike_02.listen: Double crack 60 ms apart, 400 ms of tearing, low thump, then a short rumble. LOUD and sharp: the tower strike.
SFX_LB_Thunder_Strike_02.name: SFX_LB_Thunder_Strike_02

SFX_LB_Thunder_Strike_03.name: SFX_LB_Thunder_Strike_03

SFX_LB_Wind.listen: Slow breathing wind: two drifting hollow bands (low ~250 Hz, mid ~700 Hz), gusts swelling and fading, L and R not identical. No whistling, no repeat.
SFX_LB_Wind.name: SFX_LB_Wind

SFX_LB_Wind_Howl.listen: Narrow eerie tone gliding between ~380 and ~520 Hz (about every 14 s) over a little wind. Tower / belfry howl: should be unsettling but not a pure whistle.
SFX_LB_Wind_Howl.name: SFX_LB_Wind_Howl
